about_the_game:
The Flying Dutchman is a 3D adventure puzzle platforming pirate game set in the sky.

You find yourself in the realm of the Twilight Sea, after having made a fateful deal with a mysterious entity known as the Tempest to save their crew during a catastrophic storm.

Explore the Twilight Sea!

The Twilight Sea is home to an archipelago of floating islands, each distinct and unique in the content they have to offer.

A Cozier Approach

The game is fully a singleplayer experience, focusing on the more introspective aspects to the pirate genre. With an emphasis on intentional riddle solving, clue hunting, and interconnected mysteries, you can expect an adventure that's designed with the sole player in mind.

Ten Thousand Leagues Above the Sea

The Twilight Sea is not as hostile as the pirate-filled seas, but you can still expect unique dangers! Handle yourself and your ship to avoid getting shot by cannon outposts, dungeon traps, and don't forget... falling is a long way down!

A physics-simulated sailing experience

The ship you sail will respond to forces of impact, cannons, and the environment. Sailing in the sky is no easier than the sea!

Through your pirating and adventuring, your ship may take heavy damage. You can use the sources of wood you find and chop down to repair your boat. Don't forget to patch up the holes before you have nothing left to sail!

About the Team

Team Lost at Sea came together as 4 developers part of UC Santa Cruz's Computer Science: Game Design program.

  • Graphics: Intel Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 10

short_description: Set sail for the skies! Board the Flying Dutchman and explore the mysterious Twilight Sea, uncovering the secrets of the archipelago to find an escape. Find treasure, interact with the local inhabitants, solve clues, and adventure into deep dungeons!
